floorPlans.label: Yas Riva Reserve floor plans · Reelly-hosted Aldar booklet
floorPlans.introduction: Compare the published inland and waterfront villas. Each complete drawing shows the ground and first floors together.
floorPlans.selectorLabel: Choose a Yas Riva Reserve floor plan
floorPlans.note: Aldar lists average area by villa category on its launch page. The two six-bedroom waterfront sheets share that category average. The individual drawings give layouts without exact unit areas. Confirm the signed plan and area for your villa.

review.images: Checked the publicly published Aldar launch gallery and selected eight complete render scenes for the project. The interior images show community amenities. No identifiable villa interiors were verified on the launch page. Excluded textures, duplicate crops, and assets from the sales deck that restricts screenshots and sharing.
review.location: Aldar launch release and project page establish the northeast waterfront and a planned bridge. Masterpiece Property reports 10 minutes to Zayed International Airport and 15 to Saadiyat Island from the developer material. The official launch page does not expose an exact location pin. A broker pin is not independently confirmed. Use the project-name directions fallback. Aldar launch release: https://www.aldar.com/en/news-and-media/aldar-launches-yas-riva-reserve-a-gated-villa-community-along-yas-island-s-scenic-waterfront
review.floorPlans: Reelly-hosted standalone seven-page PDF matched the previously cached original hash. Visually reviewed all physical pages, including the external general purpose classification. Retained all six complete residence sheets (physical 2–7). The drawings lack per-unit figures. Category averages 437, 482, 538, 552 and 609 sq m were checked against the official launch table. The 609 sq m average covers the waterfront six-bedroom category across both layouts. Additional Impala kitchen-variant sheets are labelled Balghaylam in the footer. Excluded them because that project name conflicts with the intended ownership.

unavailable: Signed unit-specific areas, public release of clearly owned kitchen variant sheets, confirmed entrance coordinates and a separately publishable developer map were not verified.
